name: io.github.spurvik/spurvik-mcp-server
title: Spurvik
description: EU AI Act Art. 50, 12 & 14 setup snippets, unwrapped-call scan, HMAC receipt & marking hooks.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: Project workspace root directory to scan (must contain package.json, .git, or pnpm-workspace.yaml).

environmentVariables.name: SPURVIK_MCP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional workspace root path for static unwrapped-call scans when --root is not passed.

environmentVariables.name: SPURVIK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Spurvik API key (spurvik_live_...) for project-linked telemetry with console.spurvik.com.

environmentVariables.name: SPURVIK_HMAC_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional server-side HMAC-SHA256 signing secret (>= 16 chars) for local receipt inspection.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer spurvik_live_... token for project-linked console calls (not required for the 7 zero-key read-only tools).
